Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You cup a swelling ball of magic between your hands and hurl it away before it bursts. A final twist turns the blast into a rush of fire or branching lightning.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Target / range / shape
Every creature in a visible 3-by-3 area within 5 squares.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Attack

Choose fire or lightning and the area before rolling. Affect every creature in it, including allies. Make one Guile attack using the least favorable net Boons/Banes among those targets.

Weak
Deal 4 damage of the chosen type to each target.
Standard
Deal 4 damage to each, then push each 1 square away from the area’s center.
Strong
Deal 6 damage to each, then push each 2 squares away from the center.

Resolve the pushes in an order you choose. For a target in the center square, choose its push direction before moving it.
